item.description: - **Google Antigravity:** Add an Antigravity account in Settings → Providers. Controller downloads Google's Antigravity agent, checks that Google signed it, and shares it between all your Antigravity accounts. **Sign in with Google** opens Google's page in your browser; each account keeps its sign-in in its own private profile, and Controller never sees your tokens. Gemini Enterprise, Gemini API keys and Agent Platform (Vertex AI) also work. Approval modes, the agent's questions and its tool output all appear as they do for the other agents. - **Models before the first chat:** Antigravity and Factory Droid now list their models as soon as the account connects, instead of only after the first chat started. Any account that you sign in to after connecting also loads its models straight away. - **Your whole usage history:** The Usage window now includes the history Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Grok and Factory Droid keep on your Mac, including work you did in them directly and work from before Controller was tracking. A conversation Controller also tracked counts once. The first read takes a few seconds; after that only new work is read. - **Usage from all your Macs:** Each Mac shares its usage with your other Macs over Connect, and also through your private iCloud database, so every Mac's Usage window shows everything. A **Devices** card breaks it down once another Mac contributes. Turn off **Sync usage** in Connect settings to keep iCloud out of it. - **Dictation cleanup stays in place:** While Apple Intelligence tidies a dictated message, the corrected text now wraps exactly where the message box does instead of jumping at the end, and on iPhone the microphone, spinner and waveform stay put.

Controller Connect now supports Apple, Google and passkeys through the Controller account portal.
- Existing Apple users can keep their current account, Macs and devices: choose **Continue with Apple** first, then add Google or a passkey from the account page. - Manage sign-in methods and passkeys from Settings → Connect. - Account deletion is available from settings, with a recent sign-in and explicit confirmation.
Email sign-in is not enabled. Conversations, files and agent credentials stay on your Mac.

# Release notes
## Mac and connected devices
- **Replies keep arriving after Reconnect:** Choosing **Retry** or **Reconnect** could leave every new message on "Thinking…" until Controller was quit. The agent kept working, but its replies, its requests to Controller and its progress never reached the chat, on the Mac or on your iPhone. Reconnecting now keeps them coming. - **Dictation cleanup you can watch:** When Apple Intelligence tidies a dictated message, the words it removes or changes dissolve into smoke and the corrected words form out of it, while the words it kept glide to their new places. This works on the Mac and on iPhone. With Reduce Motion on, it's a short crossfade. - **Steadier dictation waveform:** The waveform scrolls at an even pace instead of pausing and jumping ahead when the app is busy. - **Smoother animations on iPhone:** On ProMotion iPhones, Controller's own animations now run at up to 120 Hz, including the model and effort cards, the activity card, the dictation waveform and the jump-to-latest button. Before, they were held to 60 Hz. Opening the effort, context and activity cards no longer rebuilds them on every frame.
